name: Lab camera intrinsic profiles, keyed by camera identity
method: Per-camera constrained single-plane fits against the surveyed floor grid; see each camera record. Entries are matched to server slots by stable_id (AVFoundation uniqueID, which embeds the USB port) and then by a unique device_name, never by slot number -- tools/camera_service.sh renumbers slots from enumeration order at every start. An entry that matches no attached camera is dropped.

elp_4k_u3.device_model: ELP 4K USB camera, AVFoundation name '4K U3 Camera', UVC VendorID_13028 ProductID_26232
elp_4k_u3.method: Constrained single-plane fit to 40 native 3840x2160 luma frames of floor anchors [100, 103, 112] (camera fixed, optical axis ~21 deg off vertical, ~1.25 m above the grid): focal length chosen to minimise pooled PnP reprojection error of the anchors' surveyed corners; principal point fixed at the image centre, square pixels, zero skew, zero distortion. Chassis/coxa-lid normal fits were rejected as ill-conditioned for this near-top-down view; femur lids were sagging.

focal_uncertainty_band_px.note: Error floor is the floor map's 5 mm anchor tolerance, not the lens; treat focal length as +/-5 percent.

elp_4k_u3.resolution_note: Matrix is fitted at 3840x2160 and the server scales it linearly to the slot's live capture size; capture_size above pins the slot to the fitted mode. Valid only if other ELP modes are downscales of the full field; some 60 fps modes on 4K UVC modules are sensor crops. Re-fit if the capture size changes.

validation.note: Provisional. Replace with a multi-pose ChArUco/AprilTag board calibration (hexapod_tracker.lab_camera_calibration) before metrology-grade 3-D claims. The OV9281 and the 12MP AF module have no entry yet; both currently see enough floor anchors for the same fit.

source.fit_artifacts: fit on 2026-09-12 from 40 native luma frames pulled from /native-luma/<slot>.png; anchors 100, 103, 112
